{{Quote|We should get you back to the Transformation chamber. People are getting tired of looking at that ugly face of yours.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to a disguised [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Crisis on Naboo">{{TCW|Crisis on Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Transformation chamber''' was a place where a person could be disguised as another individual using a [[Facial transformation program/Legends|facial transformation program]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used it to disguise himself as [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]] during the mission to uncover the plot of [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]].
